Job Summary

Role Purpose

  • To provide a one-stop User Acceptance Test (UAT) solution with deep understanding of local business and test automation expertise.
  • Represent business on UAT and focus on end-to-end testing
  • Leverage test automation to extend test coverage & shorten time to market

Key Responsibilities

  • Review test strategy and test plan;
  • Plan test activities properly;
  • Review and analyse business requirements / user stories, identify testing scope, and work out test plan;
  • Help business improve business requirements / user stories;
  • Design test scenarios / test cases per requirement;
  • Execute test cases;
  • Develop high level design for test automation;
  • Develop maintainable common functions and utilities for project;
  • Develop maintainable, reusable, and scalable test scripts per provided test cases;
  • Build up test pipeline;
  • Raise defects with clear reproduce steps, and track defects to closure;
  • Lead a small team to complete assigned tasks;
  • Provide guidance to junior staffs and deliver training;
  • Assist in staff hiring;
  • Define / update procedures and templates;
  • Maintain good cooperative relationship with stakeholders, e.g. to establish effective communication channels, collaboratively establish clear goals and expectations, and resolve conflicts, etc

Skills And Experience

Must-have Skills

  • Test Methodology
  • Test Automation
  • Banking Business Analysis

Other Skills

  • English
  • Python
  • Quality Assurance
  • Test Management

Qualifications

Key Experiences:

  • Minimum 3 years of experience in manual testing and test automation;
  • Knowledge of QA and testing standards, methodologies, test automation tools and processes;
  • Strong analytical, numerical and problem-solving skills;
  • Knowledge in Python / Java, Git, Selenium, Jenkins;
  • Knowledge in database skills is an advantage;
  • Experience in Banking or related financial technology domain;
  • Prior work experience on Retail Banking systems and online banking systems is a plus;
  • Good stakeholder management skills in handling wide ranging stakeholders across segments/product areas;
  • Experience working across globally distributed development and test teams is a plus;

Languages

  • Good English communication skills
  • Understanding of both Traditional Chinese and Simplified Chinese;
  • Cantonese speaking is an advantage

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What We Offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

HSBC International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB)

Within International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB), we serve 41 million customers globally, including 6.7 million who are international, from retail customers to ultra high net worth individuals and their families. We help our customers to take care of their day-to-day finances and to manage, protect and grow their wealth. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our key areas of operations include Retail Banking and Wealth Management, Asset Management, Private Banking and Insurance.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team.

In This Role, You Will

Developing our Premier Elite customer base and establishing long term relationships with an assigned Premier Elite clientele portfolio

Managing the total wealth of your clients by matching our financial and investment product solutions to their financial needs

Promoting our Premier Elite Service to potential customers, exploring their needs and making referrals to other business units where appropriate

Partner with business and technical stakeholders to translate requirements into test scenarios, acceptance criteria, and risk-based test plans.
Own end-to-end testing for new initiatives and major releases, from test approach definition to production sign-off.
Ensure high product quality through functional, integration, regression, and non-functional testing.
- Test Architecture and Implementation:
Design and implement scalable test automation frameworks for API, UI, and service integration testing.
Define and maintain test data, test environments, and traceability from requirements to test evidence.
Drive shift-left quality practices, including static checks, early test design, and continuous feedback loops.
- DevOps and Tooling:
Integrate automated tests into CI/CD pipelines to support rapid and reliable releases.
Use cloud and container-based test environments to improve test consistency, scalability, and speed.
Track and report quality metrics such as test coverage, defect leakage, flaky test rate, and release readiness.
- Collaboration and Communication:
Work closely with product managers, developers, operations, and security teams to ensure quality objectives are met.
Communicate quality status, key risks, and mitigation plans clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Lead defect triage, root cause analysis, and continuous improvement initiatives.
Requirements
- At least 8 years of hands-on experience in software testing/quality engineering.
- Strong experience in 5 or more of the following areas:
- Test strategy and test planning
- API testing and automation (e.g., REST-assured, Postman/Newman)
- UI automation (e.g., Selenium, Cypress, Playwright)
- Performance testing (e.g., JMeter, Gatling)
- CI/CD and test pipeline integration (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions)
- SQL/NoSQL data validation
- Cloud-based testing (e.g., AWS)
- Containerized testing environments (e.g., Kubernetes, Docker)

Established as a joint venture in 2008, MSIM China became fully owned by Morgan Stanley Investment Management in 2023.

Benefiting from the global perspective and risk management capability of Morgan Stanley, MSIM China has established a variety of mutual fund and private fund portfolios covering fixed income, active equity, quantitative equity, multi-asset and sustainable investing strategies. Our portfolios have won many prestigious awards, including Morningstar Awards and Golden Bull Awards, which is a testament to our expertise and capabilities.

What You'll Do

Primary responsibilities will include advising investment professionals and directing outside counsel in connection with investment activities and fund structuring as well as compliance requirements arising from various regulatory and internal policy obligations.

The candidate will be responsible for legal coverage within MSIM China’s business including:

  • Interacting regularly with senior management in the business, Risk Officers, Compliance, Tax, Finance and other stakeholders to manage legal risk and protect the Firm’s reputation;
  • Providing coverage for legal aspects of fund structuring, fund formation and fund governance for complex fund structures;
  • Instructing external counsels;
  • Advising on changes in law, new regulatory initiatives and changing market practices for funds and related investments;
  • Advising on the development and execution of internal policies and procedures;

Your role

Interested in working in finance, specifically in banking, but not sure where to start? Do you want to work for a firm with a truly global footprint?

We're looking for ambitious students to join our 2027 Off-cycle Internship Program within our Global Banking business.

You’ll Get To

  • evaluate companies and develop models for M&A transactions
  • prepare industry analyses for pitches
  • get involved in the execution of live deals

Your team

You’ll be working in our Global Banking team. We’re responsible for providing coverage, advisory, capital markets and financing solutions for corporate, financial institutions and sponsor clients.

Your expertise

We’re Looking For a Candidate Who

  • is graduating between December 2027 and June 2028 and has legal working rights in Mainland China
  • has values that align with ours: hard-working, trustworthy, dedicated and collaborative
  • is a strategic thinker with strong communication skills
  • is motivated to work in a business with high demands and tight deadlines
  • can evidence how experimental and responsible use of AI can improve outcomes and efficiency

We’re looking for someone who’s curious and wants to thrive in a business that never stops moving. We welcome all majors, but it’s important to have an interest in the financial industry. We want to see what makes you unique and discover what you can bring to our team. Perhaps you’ve organized a fundraising event or taken part in team sports? Or stepped out of your comfort zone to learn about a subject you found challenging? Let us know how your achievements match the skills we’re after.

Your program

This paid internship will last six months. You’ll work with our experts and learn about the industry, our clients and our firm. You’ll be right at the heart of our business, learning from your colleagues, taking part in day-to-day operations. You'll be given mentors along the way and will have the chance to get to know some of the most senior members of our teams.

You’ll have plenty of opportunities to develop new skills and make contacts along the way. If you like challenges, enjoy learning and want to work where no two days are the same, this program is for you.

If you have a successful internship, you may get an offer to return for our Graduate Talent Program after you've completed your studies.

About Us

UBS is a leading and truly global wealth manager and the leading universal bank in Switzerland. We also provide diversified asset management solutions and focused investment banking capabilities. Headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland, UBS is present in more than 50 markets around the globe.

We know that great work is never done alone. That’s why we place collaboration at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves. Want to find out more? Visit ubs.com/careers.

Join us

At UBS, we know that it's our people, with their diverse skills, experiences and backgrounds, who drive our ongoing success. We’re dedicated to our craft and passionate about putting our people first, with new challenges, a supportive team, opportunities to grow and flexible working options when possible. Our inclusive culture brings out the best in our employees, wherever they are on their career journey. And we use artificial intelligence (AI) to work smarter and more efficiently. We also recognize that great work is never done alone. That’s why collaboration is at the heart of everything we do. Because together, we’re more than ourselves.

We’re committed to disability inclusion and if you need reasonable accommodation/adjustments throughout our recruitment process, you can always contact us.

Disclaimer / Policy Statements

UBS is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We respect and seek to empower each individual and support the diverse cultures, perspectives, skills and experiences within our workforce.

Job Summary

We are seeking a talented and motivated senior JAVA software engineer to join a high performing Scrum team to roll out new digital solution for customers. The candidate must be a skilled professional who has high availability software development experience with a desire to work on an Agile, dynamic and flat organisational structure.

Key Responsibilities

Key Roles and Responsibilities

  • Design and develop the business logic and backend systems of the product
  • Work closely with frontend developers to design and develop functional, performing and complete APIs
  • Decipher existing companies’ software systems and be able to hook in application to applicable data sources
  • Write both unit and integration tests, and develop automation tools for daily tasks
  • Develop high quality, well documented, and efficient code
  • Challenge ideas and opinions to avoid pitfalls and inefficient solutions
  • Collaborate with product managers and other tech leads to ensure applications meet functional requirements and strategic objectives.
  • Perform code reviews to guarantee quality and promote a culture of technical excellence in Java development.
  • Lead and partake in system changes, ensuring project delivery is efficient and meets quality standards, directly involving oneself in coding and problem-solving.

Strategy

  • Responsible for the quality of the code repository where applicable.

Business

  • Deliver outputs that make a significant contribution to the organization's strategic goals.

Processes

  • Responsible in the preparation of production outputs and their planning in alignment to ESDLC standards.

People & Talent

  • Mentoring and training the squad on technical skills.

Risk Management

  • Mitigate delivery risks and issues, and ensure quality, affordability, and scope of delivery.

Governance

  • Ensure all artefacts and assurance deliverables are as per the required standards and policies

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.
  • Exercise authorities delegated by the Board of Directors and act in accordance with Articles of Association (or equivalent)

Key stakeholders

  • Chapter Lead
  • Engineering Lead
  • Release Manager
  • Domain Architect
  • Business Leads / Product owners
  • Production Support

Skills And Experience

  • Spring Boot
  • Spring Framework
  • Hibernate / MyBatis
  • RESTful API
  • Problem Resolving
  • Container – OpenShift, Docker, Kubernetes
  • DB2 / Oracle / PostgreSQL
  • Messaging – Queue, Topic
  • DevOps / ADO

Qualifications

  • Minimum experience of 7 years in Java application development.
  • Proficient in RESTful API, SOAP, JDK, SpringBoot 3.x, K8S, JUnit.
  • Should have knowledge on Relational (Oracle, PostgreSQL) and/or No-SQL Databases and ability to write basic SQL queries.
  • Preferred to have knowledge on API Gateways, API security, SSL, OAuth 2, etc.
  • Develop and maintain messaging services using JMS/Solace/Kafaka.
  • Should be independently able to manage CICD tasks using Git, Azure DevOps (ADO), Maven, Ansible, and Helm Charts
  • Experienced in Container Infrastructure such as Docker, Linux, Kubernetes, OCP or AWS EKS or Azure AKS. Implement microservices architecture to ensure scalability and maintainability.
  • Have a high enthusiasm for programming and new technology learning, have a strong learning ability.
  • Fluent English speaking/listening/reading/writing. Mandarin or Cantonese language ability will be an advantage.
  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or related field, with preference given to advanced degrees.
  • Languages: English

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of Associate Director, Software Engineering (Guardrail Platform AI Safety Track).

Business: CTO Platform (AI Platforms)

Job ID: 53435

Location: Guangzhou / Xi'an

Principal Responsibilities

  • Design, develop and productionise AI safety detectors for enterprise AI applications, including prompt injection and jailbreak detection, personally identifiable information and sensitive data detection, data leakage prevention, content safety and harmful content detection, policy violation checks, system prompt leakage detection, and agent or tool-use risk controls.
  • Build detector pipelines using a multiple approaches, including rule-based detection, pattern matching, NLP / ML classifiers, embedding base models, LLM-as-a-Judge evaluators, and hybrid detection strategies with clear interfaces, confidence scoring and policy-driven actions.
  • Develop and optimize detector models and evaluation workflows for guardrails, including test sets creation, data labeling strategies, fine-tuning, model validation, threshold calibration, precision / recall optimization, regression testing, and continuous improvement based on production feedback.
  • Evaluate and integrate industry and open-source AI safety solutions, including detector frameworks, safety models and third-party services; perform build-vs-buy analysis, bechmarking, integration, and production readiness assessment.
  • Design end-to-end AI safety protection patterns across enterprise AI workloads, including RAG system, coding assistants, conversational AI and agent application covering input, retrieval, generation, output, logging and tool execution layers.
  • Build AI Safety observability and governance capabilities, including detector telemetry, tracing, dashboards, evaluation metrics, audit trails, feedback loops and operational controls to monitor safety effectiveness.
  • Partner with AI platform, infrastructure, security and application teams to productionise safety solution, including performance optimization, scalability improvement, detector lifecycle management and reliable rollout strategies.

Requirements

  • Experience developing first-party detectors for AI safety detectors, including prompt injection, jailbreak, personally identifiable information, data leakage, toxicity, policy violation or agent safety detection.
  • Experience building fine-tuning pipelines for safety-oriented large language models or small language models, including dataset curation, labelling strategy, training workflow implementation, evaluation design, and production validation.
  • Experience identifying, evaluating, integrating and productionising third-party or open-source detector solutions, with clear judgement on quality, latency, cost, operational fit and governance requirements.
  • Experience making sound build-versus-buy decisions for detector capabilities, and taking either internally developed or externally sourced solutions through evaluation, integration, rollout and ongoing operation in production.
  • Experience with AI evaluation or observability tools such as Langfuse, LangSmith, Arize, Phoenix or similar platforms.
  • Familiarity with data loss prevention, secret scanning, document classification or enterprise information protection tooling.
  • Experience with adversarial testing, red teaming or continuous attack simulation for AI systems.

You’ll achieve more when you join HSBC.

HSBC is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and, opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment. We encourage applications from all suitably qualified persons irrespective of, but not limited to, their gender or genetic information, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, social status, medical care leave requirements, political affiliation, people with disabilities, color, national origin, veteran status, etc., We consider all applications based on merit and suitability to the role. /WX

Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.

Job Summary

Develop and implement communications strategy and programs to continuously protect and promote the Bank's brand and bring to life the Bank's business strategy and core values via multiple external/internal touchpoints.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy

  • Play a pivot role in developing and implementing communications strategy consistent with the Bank’s business strategies and priorities in China
  • Continuously build profile and uplift visibility for the bank in areas relating to Corporate & Investment Banking, Branding initiatives and Corporate Social Responsibilities

Business

  • Sound knowledge of the Bank’s global franchise, China market and a good understanding of the opportunities opening up for CIB business
  • Develop and implement strategic communications plan and roadmap, focusing on the Bank's strategy and business priorities
  • Focus on the following areas of CIB business from strategy to communications programmes & execution:
  • Coverage – Corporates & Financial Institutions
  • CIB Products – TB & FM
  • Initiatives such as China Opening-up, Chinese Enterprises Going Global, RMB Internationalisation, Belt & Road, Financial Connectivity Schemes, Sustainable and Transition Finance, Digitalisation
  • Executive profiling for senior executives' thought leadership in line with respective business focuses
  • Develop press releases, executive speeches, Op-Ed, WeChat articles and LinkedIn posts for corporate and business communications related programs
  • Arrange media interviews on proactive basis for major business developments/milestones and the Bank's focus areas
  • Lead media relations for China East region and provide communications support for reputational risk management for incidents in East

Risk Management

  • Adherence to laws and regulations, internal risk and compliance policies (including anti-money laundering, sanction, anti-bribery & corruption and relevant FCC risks) and the Group Code of Conduct
  • Work closely with media monitoring agency to be aware of related media voice on potential issues and provide sound judgement and mitigation plan from communications perspective
  • Play a key role in reputational risk management for the Bank, and work as a key CABM contact window for China East Region

Governance

  • Ensure adherence to the Risk Management Framework, Group Code of Conduct and various Policies, Procedures and Guidelines of the Bank by the Group and China CABM teams
  • Play a pivotal role in guiding relevant stakeholders on communications-related guidelines and best practices
  • Maintain high awareness and understanding of the regulatory framework in which the business operates, and the regulatory requirements and expectations relevant to the role
  • Completion of all mandatory training needed including e-learning within stated timeframes to support the understanding of the roles for delivering effective governance

Regulatory & Business Conduct

  • Display exemplary conduct and live by the Group’s Values and Code of Conduct.
  • Take personal responsibility for embedding the highest standards of ethics, including regulatory and business conduct, across Standard Chartered Bank. This includes understanding and ensuring compliance with, in letter and spirit, all applicable laws, regulations, guidelines and the Group Code of Conduct.
  • Effectively and collaboratively identify, escalate, mitigate and resolve risk, conduct and compliance matters.

Key stakeholders

Internal

  • China EXCO members
  • CIB China Head Office & CIB Business
  • East CGMs
  • China & Group CABM

External

  • Media
  • Communications counterparts at regulatory/ governmental authorities
  • Key financial analysts & opinion leaders
  • General public

Other Responsibilities

  • Embed Here for good and Group’s brand and values in CABM
  • Perform other responsibilities assigned under Group, Country, Business or Functional policies and procedures;
  • Understand, acknowledge and comply with the requirements on individual accountabilities and responsibilities of the job set out in applicable local laws and regulations as well as SCB internal policies;
  • Effectively ensure and intensify internal controls by keeping abreast with developments of applicable local laws and regulations on accountabilities;
  • Perform job duties with diligence, contribute to efforts as an individual or as a team member so as to avoid any actual or potential legal sanctions, regulatory penalties, material financial loss, or adverse reputational impact on the Bank;
  • Be responsible for failure to follow relevant rules and processes, failure to properly perform the responsibilities, and implement corrections;
  • Cooperate with any investigations or reviews on regulatory failure such as accountability review.

Skills and Experience

  • Communications Strategy & Planning
  • Copywriting & Content Development
  • Media Engagement & Management
  • Reputational Risk Management
  • Strategic & Creative Thinking

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of communications experience, preferably with experience related to the financial services industry
  • Proven communications expertise, with the ability to develop and execute integrated communications strategies across earned, owned, and paid media channels
  • Strong writing, editing, and content development skills in both Chinese and English
  • Sound judgment and experience in issues and reputational risk management
  • Strong stakeholder management and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate across businesses and functions
  • Strong self-motivation, strategic thinking, adaptability, and a high-level attention to detail
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite (PowerPoint, Excel, Word and Outlook); familiarity with digital communications platforms, social media analytics and AI-enabled productivity tools is an advantage

About Standard Chartered

We're an international bank, nimble enough to act, big enough for impact. For more than 170 years, we've worked to make a positive difference for our clients, communities, and each other. We question the status quo, love a challenge and enjoy finding new opportunities to grow and do better than before. If you're looking for a career with purpose and you want to work for a bank making a difference, we want to hear from you. You can count on us to celebrate your unique talents and we can't wait to see the talents you can bring us.

Our purpose, to drive commerce and prosperity through our unique diversity, together with our brand promise, to be here for good are achieved by how we each live our valued behaviours. When you work with us, you'll see how we value difference and advocate inclusion.

Together We

  • Do the right thing and are assertive, challenge one another, and live with integrity, while putting the client at the heart of what we do
  • Never settle, continuously striving to improve and innovate, keeping things simple and learning from doing well, and not so well
  • Are better together, we can be ourselves, be inclusive, see more good in others, and work collectively to build for the long term

What we offer

In line with our Fair Pay Charter, we offer a competitive salary and benefits to support your mental, physical, financial and social wellbeing.

  • Core bank funding for retirement savings, medical and life insurance, with flexible and voluntary benefits available in some locations.
  • Time-off including annual leave, parental/maternity (20 weeks), sabbatical (12 months maximum) and volunteering leave (3 days), along with minimum global standards for annual and public holiday, which is combined to 30 days minimum.
  • Flexible working options based around home and office locations, with flexible working patterns.
  • Proactive wellbeing support through Unmind, a market-leading digital wellbeing platform, development courses for resilience and other human skills, global Employee Assistance Programme, sick leave, mental health first-aiders and all sorts of self-help toolkits
  • A continuous learning culture to support your growth, with opportunities to reskill and upskill and access to physical, virtual and digital learning.
  • Being part of an inclusive and values driven organisation, one that embraces and celebrates our unique diversity, across our teams, business functions and geographies - everyone feels respected and can realise their full potential.

Business: IWPB Technology

Job ID：61528

Ready to shape AI-augmented delivery across our retail banking platforms?

Why HSBC

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world. Guided by our purpose of opening up a world of opportunity, our ambition is to become the world’s most trusted bank globally, putting customers at the heart of everything we do.

The Role

The WPS Retail Delivery Head is a senior engineering leadership role responsible for end-to-end software engineering delivery across the Retail Banking portfolio within iWPB Wealth & Premier Solutions. The role sets technical direction while remaining hands-on across architecture, design and critical code-level decisions to deliver scalable, resilient and secure platforms. A key focus is advancing AI-augmented engineering practices across the SDLC including generative AI coding assistants and agentic workflows to improve delivery velocity and engineering quality. The role oversees mission-critical delivery outcomes while improving Run-the-Bank (RTB) efficiency through simplification, automation and legacy modernisation. Success looks like predictable delivery of high-quality software, measurable improvements in DORA metrics and strong governance across security, privacy and regulatory requirements.

What You'll Be Doing

  • Set strategic technical direction across the Retail Banking engineering portfolio while staying hands-on in architecture and design decisions
  • Oversee cross-functional teams delivering enterprise-scale retail banking software to agreed timelines, budgets and quality outcomes
  • Champion AI-augmented SDLC practices including generative AI coding assistants, automated test generation and agentic workflows
  • Establish engineering standards across clean code, microservices patterns, API-first design and modern DevSecOps automation
  • Embed DORA metrics to benchmark delivery performance and improve deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate and time to restore service
  • Strengthen RTB efficiency through technical debt remediation, system simplification, self-healing automation and legacy modernisation
  • Partner with business stakeholders, product owners and enterprise architects to translate objectives into delivery roadmaps and value outcomes
  • Govern delivery against HSBC security baselines, architectural governance, data privacy mandates and financial regulatory requirements

What We're Looking For

  • Bring substantial senior software engineering leadership experience delivering large-scale, mission-critical retail banking or enterprise platforms from concept to production
  • Demonstrate deep hands-on full-stack capability across modern front-end, microservices and enterprise engineering with active involvement in code reviews and complex debugging
  • Apply practical expertise in AI-driven engineering transformation including AI coding tools, LLM integrations and modern CI/CD and DevSecOps approaches
  • Show proven capability in architecture and technical design across complex legacy-to-modern transitions and high-volume transactional systems
  • Use DORA metrics, telemetry and engineering dashboards to improve productivity, release velocity and software quality
  • Demonstrate coaching and stakeholder management experience across diverse technical teams and executive-level partners
  • Bring strong domain knowledge in Retail Banking, Wealth Management or Financial Services including security, data privacy and regulatory compliance
  • Demonstrate equivalent knowledge and capability gained through substantial engineering practice and delivery accountability in regulated environments

Building the next Retail delivery standard

If you want to shape how retail banking platforms are built and operated at scale this role offers the scope to make a visible impact. You’ll set the technical direction for delivery while modernising engineering practices through AI-augmented workflows and strong DevSecOps foundations. The work spans critical customer-facing platforms where resilience, security and quality matter every day. If this remit matches the outcomes you’ve delivered before we’d welcome your application.

HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organisations in the world, with operations in 64 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realise their ambitions.

We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role of MGR - PROCESSING.

Principal responsibilities

Impact on the Business

  • To deliver “superior” customer service by driving operational performance, (meeting SLAs, reducing cost, driving operational efficiency and reducing operational risks).
  • Manage GSC/Business Service resources effectively to meet strategic objectives of the business.
  • Support and drive effective cross training programmes across GSC/Business Service locations to ensure that process is adequately resourced to meet the demands of the business.

Customers / Stakeholders

  • Ensure that the customer is at the heart of everything we do both personally and as an organisation.
  • To partner with Global Businesses, Transformation and other stakeholders to drive operational change programmes and have oversight of operational change programmes that impact the Business Service.
  • To assume overall responsibility for process management and operational integrity of the GSC/Business Service site.

Teamwork

  • Support other Business Service, Transformation and/or other stakeholders in driving operational change programmes.

Operational Effectiveness & Control

  • To provide a platform to enable Group companies to significantly reduce their operating costs whilst maintaining Customer service standards.
  • To continually re-assess the operational risks inherent in the business donor Group companies.
  • Ensure adequate contingency procedures are in place to minimize the impact of partial or total site failure.
  • To be aware of the nature of our customers business/trading patterns and alert to any out of the ordinary transactions, which should be escalated to Senior Management.
  • To be fully conversant with FIM, anti money laundering and sanctions and internal procedures/polices and regulatory requirements of our business.

Requirements

  • 5+ years experience in International Trade operations.
  • Strong International Trade experience and background required, in depth working knowledge of Trade business and industry standards such as UCP/ISBP/ ICC OPINIONS / URR/ URC and the ability to impart such knowledge to their team。
  • Strong Communication skills in business way with bargaining power under time critical pressure, firmly stand for the principal / balance between cost efficiency and service commitment.
  • Strong logical thinking and decision making skills with good customer orientation mindset.
  • Ability to learn and quickly transfers knowledge appropriately, understand and interpret numeric data. Evidence of good analytical skills.
  • Ability to understand and implement Group risk management.
  • Experience/knowledge in process re engineering and production management skills.

Job ID：63476

  • Accountable and responsible for mobile applications development (Android / iOS) for our everyday banking & wealth view mobile apps.
  • Write clean, highly maintainable, testable, scalable and efficient code following best practices.
  • Debug and resolve technical production issues, ensuring app stability and reliability.
  • Stay updated with the latest trends, tools, and technologies in mobile development.
  • Contribute to documentation and knowledge sharing articles.
  • Collaborate with product owners, business analysts, designers, architects, and other stakeholders to ensure that we can deliver world-class mobile applications to our customers.
  • Understanding the functional and non-functional requirements through regular interactions with the Business Analysts, SMEs and Solution Architects.
  • Provides accurate estimates and status to management, raising issues appropriately.
  • Manage a squad teams of developers performing system development work and system analysis.
  • Work with Scrum master to prioritize the items from the product backlog in the sprint planning.

Knowledge & Experience/Qualifications

  • Passionate about mobile application development with extensive experience delivering high-quality apps.
  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical fields.
  • Proficiency in:Android: Kotlin and Java, Android SDK, Android Studio, Jetpack Compose;iOS: Swift and Objective-C, Xcode, UIKit/SwiftUI.
  • Strong knowledge of mobile architecture e.g.: MVVM.
  • Strong knowledge on object-oriented programming, functional programming, and reactive programming.
  • Strong knowledge and have practical experience with Redux (or similar state management patterns).
  • Strong understanding of RESTful APIs concepts and integration mechanisms.
  • Strong understanding of Apple / Google mobile development principles & best practices.
  • Strong understanding of Behavior-Driven-Development (BDD), including writing & maintaining BDD test scripts for Android and/or iOS.
  • Proficiency in building composable UI components using Jetpack Compose (Android) or SwiftUI (iOS).
  • Familiar with version control systems: Git.
  • Familiar on DevOps tooling: Jenkins, Splunk, , Nexus, Jira, Confluence etc.
  • Able to work effectively with cross region, multi-cultural development teams.
  • Ability to explain complex technical problems / solutions to audiences at different technical background / knowledge.
  • Strong problem solving and analytic skills, able to work independently and under pressure.
  • Strong work ethic and team player experienced working with Scrum/Agile development methodologies
  • Strong analytical, design and problem solving skills; excellent team player with ability to work under pressure with minimal supervision
  • Real passion for elegance and efficiency in software engineering and always strive for continuous improvements via automated processes
  • Work closely with both local and global teams on the project delivery with agile/DevOps manners.
  • A good team player with strong analytical/troubleshooting skills, and self-motivated
  • Flexible and adaptable in accommodating change of requirement and willing to take new responsibilities when necessary.
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills and fluent in English. Proficient in Mandarin / Cantonese is desirable.
